# Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Training: 40-Hour, 24-Hour & 8-Hour Refresher

> Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Training: 5 self-paced online courses from $39.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [Cal/OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-518): $39.99 per person, 1 hour, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) Standards for the Construction Industry (29 CFR 1926.65) and General Industry (29 CFR 1910.120). Enroll: https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=518. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/cal-osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training
- [Cal/OSHA Chemical Handling Safety Training](https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-682): $55.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Title 8 California Code of Regulations Section 5194, 5141, and 5155. Enroll: https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=682. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/calosha-chemical-handling-safety-training
- [Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-490): $149.99 per person, 8 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Regulations in Title 8, Section 5192 Paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e). Enroll: https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=490. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training
- [Cal/OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-496): $189.99 per person, 24 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Regulations in Title 8, Section 5192 Paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e). Enroll: https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=496. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/cal-osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training
- [Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026)](https://cal-osha-hazwoper.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-351): $229.99 per person, 40 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months.
